name: Michelnhof
beschreibung: The Michelnhof campsite is located on the quiet outskirts of St. Johann in Tirol. The site is situated at the foot of the Kitzbüheler Horn in the mountains of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The site is a starting point for hikes and mountain bike tours in summer as well as for the surrounding ski areas in winter. The facilities include pitches for motorhomes and caravans, tent areas and sanitary buildings. On the grounds there is a restaurant with an outdoor terrace and a pizzeria. Most pitches have electricity and water connections, and a playground is available. The campsite is open all year round and offers accommodation for vacationers and travelers passing through.
